overlaps.detail: Both developments construct function fields, DVR places and valuation/divisor infrastructure. AlgebraicCurves develops arbitrary one-variable function fields; EllipticCurves specializes an explicit nonsingular Weierstrass equation, its point at infinity and its equation-level point group. Neither the shared vocabulary nor a general genus-one theorem establishes a dependency between the present implementations.
overlaps.proposal: Keep general function-field/place and divisor infrastructure in AlgebraicCurves, and Weierstrass presentations, explicit infinity orders and their point-group comparisons in EllipticCurves. Specify comparison maps between the two carriers before replacing the elliptic construction by an import. In particular, do not require general Riemann–Roch for the elementary elliptic Picard computation.
